question: What is the meaning of suppliers of components in relation to supply chain?
description: Suppliers of components are entities that provide raw materials or intermediate products to other companies in the supply chain. They play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and availability of materials used in the production process. In the context of sustainable construction, suppliers of components can be key stakeholders in promoting environmentally friendly practices and ensuring the durability of remanufactured components.
